parameters.parameter: Machine should have a stable base with sturdy locking wheel mechanism
Digital control equipped with an easy ready display indicating with precision
Soft positioning arms for accurate tube positions
Exclusive angular indicating system for head positioning in various radiography techniques
Should have free swivel head, which allows easy positioning of head
Compliance to Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017 as amended till date
Availability of valid medical device license for the product issued from the competent authority defined under Drugs and Cosmetic Act 1940 and Rules made there under as amended till date
Conformity to Indian Standard IS 7620- Part 1, Part 2, Part 3
Warranty (Option of comprehensive warranty is available through bidding only, which if opted will supersede normal warranty in the catalogue)
